Sepultura

Country of origin:
Brazil
Location:
Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais (early); São Paulo, São Paulo (later)
Status:
Active
Formed in:
1984
Genre:
Death/Thrash Metal (early); Nu-Metal, Groove/Thrash Metal (later)
Themes:
Satanism, Death, Evil (early); Politics, Society, Literature (later)
Current label:
Nuclear Blast Records
Years active:
1984-present
Pictured from left to right: Derrick Green, Andreas Kisser, Paulo Xisto, Greyson Nekrutman.

The band name comes from a Portuguese translation of Motörhead's song "Dancing on Your Grave", which is "Dançando na sua Sepultura". Sepultura means "grave" (sepulchre) in Portuguese (and in some other Latin-based languages). Originally, they wanted to call the band Tropa de Choque (Shock Troops), but ...
